review_summary: Independent JARVIS visual review approves V01 Layer 03. The GitHub Actions artifact was downloaded and candidate.png independently hashed to 9c855ce50bea0032a17e0b6a230d7282dc1c078116dc0210b7fd33bcc525b6af, exactly matching the candidate manifest and published state. Against the approved Layer 02 parent, the new contribution remains confined to the three wall-shelf compositions. The shelf merchandise gains a gentle integrated warm glow and slightly stronger local material response without creating raw strip lines, LED-dot texture, visible surface fixtures, or a bright shelf-edge graphic. The previously approved wall-wash and counter hierarchy remain visually intact, the sweet counter is still the strongest retail destination, the ceiling stays quiet, and unrelated circulation, seating, central-display, and counter zones do not visibly shift. The difference is restrained but legible enough to communicate the intended second shelf-lighting family in a layered presentation while keeping the office-display-shelf character rather than generic cabinet strip lighting.
hard_locks: Candidate 9c855ce50bea0032a17e0b6a230d7282dc1c078116dc0210b7fd33bcc525b6af is the immutable approved V01 Layer 03 parent and must not be regenerated or reinterpreted unless explicitly reopened by JARVIS.
Camera, crop, focal character, perspective, architecture, ceiling grid, counters, shelves, furniture, products, materials, and colours remain locked for all later V01 layers.

Approved Layer 01 counter lighting, Layer 02 wall-wash, and Layer 03 concealed shelf-integrated lighting are frozen in intensity, colour, source concealment, beam character, reflections, and shadow behaviour except for physically unavoidable interaction from a newly added circuit.
All later electric lighting remains 3000K and recessed, concealed, or integrated only. No pendant, track, surface fixture, raw LED strip line, or LED-dot texture is permitted.

Layer 04 must equal approved Layer 03 plus exactly one newly released central-merchandise or circulation lighting family. Unrelated zones may not brighten, darken, or shift colour without physical cause.
Do not use global exposure or gamma changes to simulate added light.
Presentation generation remains locked until every required view has valid independent JARVIS approvals through completion.
